title: Dark Peasant Powers (TABS Inspired)
description: Adds TABS-inspired Dark Peasant powers to Minecraft: orbiting black hands, enemy grabbing and throwing, projectile blocking, and a violent black tide shockwave.
body:
# Dark Peasant Powers (TABS Inspired)

A high-quality Minecraft datapack that brings the devastating abilities of the **Dark Peasant** from *Totally Accurate Battle Simulator (TABS)* into Minecraft. 

> **Notice:** This datapack grants the player powers; it does not add the Dark Peasant as a standalone mob.

---

## ⚠ Required Resource Pack

This datapack **REQUIRES** the companion resource pack to function. Without it, the "Black Hands" and other visual effects will not display correctly (appearing as missing textures or invisible entities).

**How to download:**
The resource pack is attached to each version as an **Additional File**. When you download the datapack, please ensure you also download the **"Dark Peasant RP.zip"** from the files section.

---

## ✨ Features: The Black Hands System

Once enabled, several shadowy black hands will orbit the player, automatically reacting to nearby threats with advanced combat logic:

* **Offensive Maneuvers:**
    * **Auto-Attack:** Automatically strikes nearby hostile mobs.
    * **Grab & Lift:** Seizes enemies and hoists them into the air.
    * **Smash & Throw:** Slams grabbed enemies into the ground or hurls them into other mobs for collateral damage.
* **Defensive Mastery:**
    * **Projectile Blocking:** Shields the player by intercepting incoming arrows and projectiles.
    * **Mod Compatibility:** Designed to intercept special projectile-like entities from various popular mods.

---

## 🎮 How to Use

To enable or disable your powers, use the following command in-game:

```mcfunction
/function darkhands:toggle
